onset.Description: Time in seconds from the start of the acquisition when the event occurred.

duration.Description: Duration in seconds of the event.

trial_type.Description: Categorical label indicating the type of trial or condition.

Levels.neutral_females: 2 female PLDs doing a 'go overthere' motion

response_time.Description: Reaction time in seconds; the time taken by the participant to respond.
response_time.Note: Use 'n/a' if no response was recorded.

response_accuracy.Description: Accuracy of the participant's response for the trial (1 = correct, 0 = incorrect).

trial_no.Description: Trial number in the sequence of trials.
